programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Chef Phillip takes on the Epicurean Market Challenge. Try and taste everything and then talk to the chefs about what he is eating. This episode features chefs that are famous now and some who will be in the future.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Chef Phillip gives us a first hand rundown on what's on offer in the Epicurean Market and why this event, now in its third year, doubles its attendance every year.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: This is the last day of the market event and everyone is in party mode. However, the business of eating is Chef Phillip's main task and he doesn't fail on any level.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Phillip takes into the realms of the megastar chefs. We get close-ups of Tetsuya, Quek and some more of Silverton, Wolfgang Pukc, Gordon and Batali. This episode is crammed full of advice, tips and recipes.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: What makes the Epicurean Market actually work? We find out. Then there's more tips, more fun with the Mystery Box Challenge, highlights of the weekend including a curry master class from David Thompson. It' a full celebration of an epic Epicurean event.
